about: The Workbench icons of the F1Spirit drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own icon (build/linux/f1spirit.png, with the game). F1Spirit-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, F1Spirit.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's F1Spirit.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-f1spirit, COPYING.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the icon of every subdrawer (demos, graphics, sound, tracks, User).
